fields.incident_description_long:
INCIDENT: Deepfake / manipulated media incident
CASE REFERENCE (local): case_6c6f19082755

DESCRIPTION
A viral AI image from a Boredpanda article. Shows the verdict, where it was found, forensic modules and what to do next. Source: https://www.boredpanda.com/school-photos-of-celebrities-created-with-ai/

FORENSIC FINDINGS (indicators, not conclusions)
- Website: direct media link: Moderate manipulation indicators (forensic indicators level: Moderate).

LOCATIONS WHERE THE MEDIA WAS FOUND
- https://static.boredpanda.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/School-photos-of-Celebrities-created-with-AI-64ef322c0e0d0-png__700.jpg | Website | account: unknown | published: 30-08-2023 17:42 IST | state at last check: live (19-10-2026 19:38 IST)

TIMELINE
- 30-08-2023 17:42 IST: Published — Website: static.boredpanda.com [Inferred; source: HTTP Last-Modified header (server-declared, not proof of creation)]
- 19-10-2026 19:38 IST: Case opened [Verified; source: system clock]
- 19-10-2026 19:38 IST: Original evidence file preserved (School-photos-of-Celebrities-created-with-AI-64ef322c0e0d0-png__700.jpg) [Verified; source: custody ledger]
- 19-10-2026 19:38 IST: Captured by investigator — Website: static.boredpanda.com (live) [Verified; source: system clock at capture]

WHAT IS NOT YET KNOWN
- Who created the media and who operates the accounts listed above. The accounts are listed because they were observed posting the media. This is not an allegation that they created it.

REQUESTED ACTION
- Removal of the content from all platforms listed.
- Preservation of account, login and upload records for the accounts listed, pending investigation.
- Investigation into the creation and distribution of the media.

platform_reports.how: Contact the site's abuse address, then the hosting provider's abuse contact (shown under domain intelligence).
platform_reports.text: I am the person depicted (or reporting on their behalf). The following content is AI-manipulated media impersonating me. Please remove it and preserve related account data. URLs: https://static.boredpanda.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/School-photos-of-Celebrities-created-with-AI-64ef322c0e0d0-png__700.jpg. Under India's IT Rules 2021, intermediaries are expected to act promptly on complaints about intimate or impersonating (including artificially morphed) content.
